Bank Math Master.question: ১) Tickets numbered 1 to 20 are mixed up and then a ticket is drawn at random. What is the probability that the ticket drawn has a number which is a multiple of 4 or 5?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Tickets numbered 1 to 20 are mixed up and then a ticket is drawn at random. What is the probability that the ticket drawn has a number which is a multiple of 4 or 5?

Solution: 
Here, S = {1, 2, 3, 4, ...., 19, 20}. {4, 8, 12, 16, 20}{5,10,15,20}
Let E = event of getting a multiple of 3 or 5 = {4, 5, 8 , 10, 12, 15, 16, 20}

P(E) = n(E)/n(S) = 8/20 = 2/5

Bank Math Master.question: ৭) The universal set of U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} and A = {1, 3, 5}, B = {3, 5, 6} then determine (A′ ∩ B′)
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: The universal set of U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} and A = {1, 3, 5}, B = {3, 5, 6} then determine (A′ ∩ B′)

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}
A = {1, 3, 5}
B = {3, 5, 6}

A‘ = U - A
= {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} - {1, 3, 5}
= {2, 4, 6}

B‘ = U - B
= {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} - {3, 5, 6}
= {1, 2, 4}

এখন,
(A‘ ∩ B‘) = {2, 4, 6} ∩ {1, 2, 4}
= {2, 4}

Bank Math Master.question: ৮) From a pack of 52 cards, two cards are drawn together at random. What is the probability of both the cards being queens?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: From a pack of 52 cards, two cards are drawn together at random. What is the probability of both the cards being queens?

Solution: 
Let S be the sample space 
Then n(S) = 52C2 = (52 × 51)/(1 × 2) = 26  × 51

Let 
n(E) = event of getting 2 queens out of 4
n(E) = 4C2 = 6

P(E) = n(E)/n(S) = 6/(26  × 51) = 1/221

Bank Math Master.question: ১১) If x > y, z < y and w < x which of the following is always true?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If x > y, z < y and w < x which of the following is always true?

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
x > y, z < y
∴ x > y > z

∴ w < x অর্থাৎ x বড় w ছোট।
কিন্তু y ও z এর সাথে w এর কোন সম্পর্ক নেই।

∴ x বড় z ছোট।
∴ x > z অথবা, z < x এটাই সত্য।

Bank Math Master.question: ১২) A bag contains 2 red, 3 green and 2 blue balls. Two balls are drawn at random. What is the probability that none of the balls drawn is blue?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A bag contains 2 red, 3 green and 2 blue balls. Two balls are drawn at random. What is the probability that none of the balls drawn is blue?

Solution: 
Total number of balls
= (2 + 3 + 2)
= 7


Then, n(S) = Number of ways of drawing 2 balls out of 7
= 7C2 = 21


Let E = Event of 2 balls, none of which is blue
∴ n(E) = Number of ways of drawing 2 balls out of (2 + 3) balls
= 5C2 = 10

∴P(E) = n(E)/n(S) = 10/21

Bank Math Master.question: ১৪) If P = {x ∈ N : 2 < x ≤ 6} and Q = {x ∈ N : x even number and x ≤ 8} then what is the value of (P ∩ Q)?

Question: If P = {x ∈ N : 2 < x ≤ 6} and Q = {x ∈ N : x even number and x ≤ 8} then what is the value of (P ∩ Q)?

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
P = {x ∈ N : 2 < x ≤ 6}
∴ P = {3, 4, 5, 6}

Q = {x ∈ N : x জোড় সংখ্যা এবং x ≤ 8}
∴ Q = {2, 4, 6, 8}

এখন,
(P ∩ Q) = {3, 4, 5, 6} ∩ {2, 4, 6, 8}
= {4, 6}

Bank Math Master.question: ১৯) If |x + 2| = |x - 1| then what is the value of x?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Quesion: If |x + 2| = |x - 1| then what is the value of x?

Solution:
|x + 2| = |x - 1|
⇒ |x + 2|2 = |x - 1|2
⇒ (x + 2)2 = (x - 1)2
⇒ x2 + 4x + 4 = x2 - 2x + 1
⇒ 6x = - 3
∴ x = - 1/2

Bank Math Master.question: ২০) In a simultaneous throw of two dice what is the probability of getting a total of 10 or 11?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: In a simultaneous throw of two dice what is the probability of getting a total of 10 or 11?

Solution:
If two dices are thrown total events = (6 × 6) = 36
Event of getting a total of 10 or 11 = {(4, 6), (5, 5), (6, 4), (5, 6), (6, 5)}
Expected events = 5

∴ Probability = 5/36

Bank Math Master.question: ২১) If n(A ∪ B) = 61, n(A) = 30, n(B) = 54 then what is the value of n(A ∩ B)?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If n(A ∪ B) = 61, n(A) = 30, n(B) = 54 then what is the value of n(A ∩ B)?

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
n(A ∪ B) = 61
n(A) = 30
n(B) = 54

আমরা জানি,
n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B)
⇒ 61 = 30 + 54 - n(A ∩ B)
⇒ n(A ∩ B) = 84 - 61
∴ n(A ∩ B) = 23

Bank Math Master.question: ২৩) One card is drawn at random from a pack of 52 cards. What is the probability that the card drawn is a face card?

Solution:

Total card = 52

Bank Math Master.question: ২৫) A committee of 3 members is to be selected out of 3 men and 2 women. What is the probability that the committee has at least woman?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A committee of 3 members is to be selected out of 3 men and 2 women. What is the probability that the committee has at least woman?

Solution:
Total Person = 3 + 2 = 5
Committee can be form

       Men (3)     -   Women (2)
1)        2                     1
2)        1                     2

∴ Expected events = (3C2 × 2C1) + (3C1 × 2C2)
= (3 × 2) + (3 × 1)
= 6 + 3
= 9

Total events = 5C3 = 10

∴ Probability = 9/10
